comment: Owner topic holds. An item matching a hold is treated like a paused id: never evaluated, never published, never lost; it stays queued until the hold is released (remove the entry in a reviewed commit). Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, on title/source/summary and on the fetched record text before any AI call. 'neuromod' matches the company name only; it does NOT match 'neuromodulation'.
